description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9): the crown's oath by sabotage. It starts when the deserters mark the engines (spared: world.aldmere.engines_marked) or the first of Aldmere's seven war engines falls. Wreck the war camp's four engines (two catapults, two ballistae), then Ballista Ridge's three ballistae (quest.ballista_ridge's errand) - smashed or, at stage 6, torn up and thrown; each is an offence against Aldmere, which turns hostile. The last one writes the oath's outcome sabotage (first write wins) with oath.crown.met (M8 gate, F39: quest.oath_crown then pays its meet and resolve stages even when the herald was never met): the army withdraws (world.aldmere.army_withdrawn). Given up once the oath is won another way.

stages.objective: Wreck the war camp's four engines
stages.waiting_text: Two catapults and two ballistae stand at the camp's north side. Smash them (or, at stage 6, grab and throw them); their crews and the camp's soldiers will fight you.

stages.objective: Silence the three ballistae on Ballista Ridge
